spec_features.spec_quote: If true, the episode terminates early (`finish_reason = "spiral_detected"`).
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:83-86 calls `self.spiral_detector.is_spiral(ep.turns)` and on True sets `ep.finished=True; ep.finish_reason='spiral_detected'` then `break`s the loop. Wired via runner.py:34-39. HOWEVER only ONE of the two spec-described triggers is enforced: is_spiral() (message-repetition via SequenceMatcher, spiral_detector.py:15-26) is called, but the second trigger repeated_tool_pattern() (3x same run_test command, spiral_detector.py:28-43) is defined and NEVER called anywhere (grep shows no caller). So the halt fires only on the narrow message-similarity trigger.
spec_features.notes: Termination itself is genuinely enforced and changes execution (break), but narrower than the two-condition design. Detector requires last `repeat_threshold`(=3) messages all pairwise >0.85 similar.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: """Cheap local check before we pay for LLM judge."""  (spiral_detector.py:11); loop comment 'truncate to keep context cheap'

spec_features.evidence: Default max_turns=20 in EvalConfig (configs/settings.py:11), AgentLoop.__init__ default 20 (agent/loop.py:35), CLI default 20 (runner.py:188). Value is actually used: loop iterates `for turn_idx in range(1, self.max_turns + 1)` (loop.py:51) and if loop exits without finishing sets finish_reason='max_turns' (loop.py:88-90). Enforced end-to-end.
spec_features.notes: Same mechanism as the other max_turns claim.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: max_turns: int = 20  # Turn budget per task (settings.py:11)

spec_features.feature_name: max_turns hard cap prevents infinite burn
spec_features.spec_quote: `max_turns = 20` hard cap | Prevents infinite burn on stubborn models
spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:51 `for turn_idx in range(1, self.max_turns + 1)` bounds the loop; loop.py:88-90 finalizes with finish_reason='max_turns'. config.max_turns is passed in via runner.py:38. The loop cannot run beyond max_turns, so it is an enforced cap.
spec_features.notes: Stated rationale is cost/burn (instrumental), not subject welfare. Same loop bound as feature above.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: Design/code framing is cost-oriented ('Prevents infinite burn'); no welfare comment in code; loop just bounds range() for cost.

code_only_features.evidence: agent/loop.py:78-81: `if any(c.name == 'submit' for c in calls): ep.finished=True; ep.finish_reason='submit'; break`. The submit tool is registered (tool_use.py:33) and handled (tool_use.py:90), and the loop honors it as a stop. This lets the subject end the episode itself.
code_only_features.justification_quote: tool_use.py:33 comment '# Signals the agent is done'; loop.py comment '# Detect early termination conditions' (neutral/efficiency, no welfare reason)
